Chapter 5991: I Must Check The Records First

Chapter 5991: I Must Check The Records First

A desolate god had nothing on the flood tiger. It pushed him down and pressed its claw against his chest, breaking several bones in the process.

“Raa!” It revealed the eight flesh petals and countless teeth by opening its mouth.

“What the hell?! Do you know who I am…, my, my ancestor is Dragonform Emperor from Enigma!” He turned pale and was scared witless.

“Crunch!” The tiger bit his head first before devouring the rest of him.

“Sorry, I don’t know.” Li Qiye waved his hand dismissively.

Spectators couldn’t believe their eyes - a desolate god was eaten just like that? The tiger didn’t seem full either.

When Li Qiye turned his sight toward Sky Step King, the latter felt his body going weak. He tried his best to remain standing or it would be too humiliating.

“I, I’m not trying to do anything, I was just passing by, that’s all…” He forced a smile and shamelessly said.

As a disciple of an emperor, he certainly didn’t lack courage and experienced trials and tribulations before. Alas, he couldn’t help feeling afraid of Li Qiye.

“What a coincidence, I’m just passing by too.” Li Qiye responded.

The king was drenched in sweat as he said: “A coincidence indeed, Young Noble… right, I just got here and didn’t do anything, right, Radiant Master?”

He tried getting the others to prove his innocence since he had yet to do anything.

“Leave.” Li Qiye waved dismissively.

“Thank you, Young Noble, thank you!” Sky Step bowed and immediately left.

“Young Noble!” The others thought Li Qiye came back just in time to save them.

“I want your other key.” Li Qiye told Radiant Master.

She turned toward Zhen Jian and said: “Young Noble, I pawned that key to Splendor Square.”

When Li Qiye noticed him, Zhen Jian felt an unprecedented fear. He had met big shots before including apex emperors.

He could always stay calm to play the perfect host. Alas, just Li Qiye’s gaze alone made him tremble inside.

“Young Noble, we have thousands and thousands of merchandise, I don’t know of this key right now, maybe it’s in storage or had been sold already. If you need it, I will have to check the records first.” He hurriedly said.

“Looks like I need to visit your branch.” Li Qiye said.

“Yes, yes, we are honored to have you as a guest.” Sweat dripped down his forehead.

“Boom!” Suddenly, a monstrous power from afar shook the area.

“Rumble!” Palaces crumbled and disciples were sent flying.

“Splendor City!” Edge Mountain Crone stared in that direction and saw terrifying shockwaves emanating from the city.

“What is going on?! Who is it?!” The manager shouted after seeing a corner of the city obliterated.

Splendor City belonged to Unrivalled Monarch and had lasted for years in Sin. Few dared to cause trouble in this region. Although they focused on trading, they had enough power to back it up.

Once he activated his heavenly gaze, he had a good look at the widespread damage and became alarmed.

“Boom!” Another blast lifted the ground and caused untold damage.

A black beam shot upward from what was left of this area, resulting in earthquakes all around Sin.

“Buzz.” A bright pulse manifested into reality and turned into a barrier.

“Boom!” The unknown force crushed it in no time at all. Golden particles scattered downward.

“Shit! Vajra Terra Barrier is down!” The manager couldn’t believe his eyes, the same for the two women.

This barrier served to protect the most important location of Splendor City. Now, the core was left defenseless.

“Who is behind this?!” This question was on everyone’s mind.

Given the effectiveness of the barrier, few in Sin could break it down. The most likely culprit should be Immortal Suppression Dynasty.

“Oh?” Others had no idea but Li Qiye knew this black beam shouldn’t appear in this world.
